Source:
import functools
events=[]
class Names:
 def __iter__(self):
  events.append("first")
  yield "tag"
  events.append("second")
  yield "__name__"
class Wrapped:
 @property
 def tag(self):events.append("tag");return "ok"
 __name__="wrapped"
def wrapper():pass
functools.update_wrapper(wrapper,Wrapped(),assigned=Names(),updated=())
print(wrapper.tag,events)
